state.persona: Traveler already in Monaco during the Monaco Yacht Show, on a phone (390px wide), wants a good decision for what to do tonight. Knows nothing about the product internals.
state.jtbd: Decide where to go tonight, now.
state.entry: Tapped MORE in the bottom nav, then 'Now - Tonight's scene'.
state.first_viewport_visible_text: Header: MERIDIAN, search icon, PROFILE. Banner: 'Set your traveler lens — it takes under a minute, and you can skip. Begin / Skip'. Eyebrow 'NOW · LOCAL DECISION ENGINE'. H1 'Where should we go right now?'. Body 'Give MERIDIAN the moment you are actually in. It filters what is viable, reads the local energy, and gives you three decisions instead of another directory.' Photo card 'MERIDIAN / THE MOMENT BEFORE' (rooftop bar photo, credit PattayaPatrol). 'YOUR NEXT MOVE 01 / 03'. H2 'Make tonight worth the story.' Text 'When live nearby search is connected, start with where you are and the mood you want. NOW will give each recommendation a reason to exist.'
state.below_the_fold_in_order: Button-link 'Explore the world calendar ↗' (goes to the home/world page). Steps '01 Where you are 02 What feels right 03 A considered shortlist'. Small print 'Editorial archive photo, not a nearby venue result. Venue results appear only after you ask NOW to search.' Then (about 1000px down) a note: 'Live nearby venue search is awaiting its provider and private budget store. NOW cannot return live recommendations yet. Explore places and seasons ↗' (also goes to the home page). '01 · WHERE YOU ARE: Location stays off until live nearby search is ready.' (no location button, no city picker). '02 · WHAT YOU WANT' five tappable, working choice cards (Eat, Drinks, Music, Do something, Surprise me). '03 · VIBE' four working pills. '04 · CONSTRAINTS' working selects for radius, time, party size, max price. At the very bottom (about 2150px down) the button 'Find my next move' is disabled, with no message next to it.
state.home_page_fact: The home page that both links lead to has a card 'ALREADY THERE? Make tonight a story. Find your next stop with NOW.' which links back to this NOW page.
state.not_offered: No link to the Monte-Carlo destination page (which has editorial picks such as 'A table with a harbor line' and 'Port Hercules dawn'), no link to ACCESS, no manual city choice, no suggestion of an alternative app or source.
